_readme: One list for every game's articles. The /coc/ strip, the /articles/ feed and its per-game pages are all built from it (article-cards.js). Publishing = write /articles/<game>/<id>.html, then set status to "live" and fill in date. status "soon" = greyed card, no link. Order here = order in the strips; the feed puts live ones first, newest date first. "lead": true pins that article as the big one in the /coc/ Articles section (nowhere else). id is the URL slug: never change it once live. games: every game that can have articles; "related" = the game shown in the bottom nav's middle-right slot on that game's article pages (game-nav.json "articles-<game>").
